regions.name: MIDDLE EAST
regions.text: Turkey cut its key interest rate by 100 basis points to 36%, its first cut in 9 months.

regions.name: ASIA
regions.text: The IMF forecasts a 1.3% contraction in Pakistan, followed by 6.6% growth in 2027.

regions.name: THE AMERICAS
regions.text: SoFi launched a tokenized deposit, which is a digital balance, offering a 4.4% annual interest rate.

cover_dek: Stock futures fell before Wall Street opened for trading.
big_headline: Nasdaq futures crashed over 500 points before the market opened.
big_body: Dow futures slipped 200 points while the S&P 500 fell 0.09% and Nasdaq edged lower 1.06% as oil prices topped $111.
pol_body: The Central Bank of Ireland fined Coinbase €3.25 million. The regulator cited failures in safeguarding customer funds and the mixing of money with other entities.
biz_body: The bank is removing roles to save money by using artificial intelligence, which is computer software that mimics human tasks.
up_headline: Bank of Japan to keep rate at 1.25%
up_body: The Bank of Japan will hold its rate at 1.25% at its meeting next week, Nikkei Asia reported.
